question: Why does the realized person see the Shiva principle as unbroken true being in all comings and goings?
premises: All comings and goings are pervaded by Shiva.
Nothing in these movements falls outside Shiva's nature.
The realized person directly perceives this undivided reality.
inference: Because every movement is Shiva-filled, the realized person sees the Shiva principle as unbroken true being.
plain_english: Since all comings and goings are wholly made of Shiva, such a person clearly sees the Shiva principle as unbroken, true being.
